# /crav1-meeting-to-specs

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From a meeting to specs](../../from-meeting.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-meeting-to-specs/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Extract requirements, decisions, changes, open questions, and bugs from minutes, a transcript, an email, or a chat thread, and match each quote to existing specs.

When the user brings minutes, a transcript, an email, or a chat thread, **[`/crav1-meeting-to-specs`](crav1-meeting-to-specs.md)** extracts the requirements, decisions, changes, open questions, and bugs, and matches each quote to specs that already exist. An email or a chat thread is accepted as well as minutes or a transcript. The kind is `meeting`, `email`, or `chat`, from what the input shows. The date comes from the input. Each item is a quote, with speaker and time when the input shows them. Small talk is dropped. When more than one existing spec could fit, every candidate stays listed. Nothing is dropped to keep the list short. Each item that matches an existing spec shows one line, `State: <state>.`, and a short reason that names the evidence, in the item block and in the question. The states are built, partly built, planned, and not built. `Fits: none` has no state line. Evidence is that slice’s `spec.md` (including `## Match`), `plan.md`, `tasks.md` checkboxes, and `verify.md` when present. When those do not settle it, one read-only look at the code that spec or plan points to. A code-based or uncertain state is labeled `(inference, not in the docs)`. The line does not change keep, leave, dismiss, or note. It is not written and it is not passed to [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) as quote text. The user takes them one at a time: keep, leave, dismiss, or note. Note keeps the quote in `docs/notes/` without tying it to a spec yet. Dismiss is for this run only. The next run starts fresh. A kept addition goes to that spec through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md). The quote starts with `From <kind> <date>.` when there is a date, otherwise `From <kind>.` The impact check still runs there. A kept new feature names [`/crav1-spark-to-spec`](crav1-spark-to-spec.md), [`/crav1-ideas-to-spec`](crav1-ideas-to-spec.md), or [`/crav1-intake-to-specs`](crav1-intake-to-specs.md). A kept bug names [`/crav1-fix-bug`](crav1-fix-bug.md). Those commands are not run. When a kept addition imports a source, the skill writes `docs/sources/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/` following the imported-sources convention and does not write the spec. It does not commit. It is cross-cutting. It may run from any lane. It does not move work into a lane. It is a later skill. It is not a starter option. Asking for startup options names only the seven and does not run this command. The seven starter options stay unchanged.

Minutes, a transcript, an email, or a chat thread → quotes matched to existing specs, keep, leave, dismiss, or note one at a time. A kept addition goes through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md). A clear answer to a spec open question is linked under it.

## Runs when

Minutes, an email, or a chat. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: That input and existing spec folders.

Reads the minutes, transcript, email, or chat after the command, and existing `docs/specs/<slug>/` folders, skipping `_template`. For an item that matches a slice, also reads that slice’s `spec.md` (including `## Match`), `plan.md`, `tasks.md`, and `verify.md` when present, and the code that spec or plan points to only when those files do not settle the build state.

## Writes

In short: A source folder when a kept addition imports one, `docs/notes/` when the user picks Note, the transfer data policy after a yes; answer links and asked marks through [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md).

When a kept addition imports a source, writes `docs/sources/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/` following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/sources.md`, and does not write the spec. When the user picks Note, writes `docs/notes/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` and `docs/notes/index.md`. It reads `docs/notes/` first. An item already noted is not written again. That check may write the transfer data policy after a yes. Cursor: `.cursor/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.mdc`. Claude Code project: `.claude/rules/crav1-transfer-data-policy.md`. It never writes a secrets choice into that file. For a mail, it lists each embedded image, inline or attached. It recommends convert to text when the image is a diagram, a table, or text that can be reproduced exactly, and compress otherwise. It asks once before the source folder is written. Auto-accept applies to those recommendations only when the transfer data policy clearly covers them.

## Does not

Leaves `docs/system/`, specs, marks, and dismissals alone. Does not commit.

Limits and exceptions: no input stops and asks. The kind and the date come from the input, one of each for the run. An unclear kind, or no date, is one question. Note records the quote in `docs/notes/` and does not ask what kind of note it is. Dismiss is this run only and is not stored. Dismiss stays for a greeting, scheduling, and thanks. A kept new feature or bug only names the next command. A build-state line on a matched item is informational. It is not quote text. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. It is not a starter option.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-resolve-questions`](crav1-resolve-questions.md); [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) for one kept addition. That handoff runs the research check in `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/research-stale.md`. This skill does not run it a second time and does not write the stale block. A clear answer to a spec open question is handed to [`/crav1-add-to-spec`](crav1-add-to-spec.md) as an answer link without a keep question, with the asked marks the input shows, following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/open-questions.md`. An unclear or partial answer is shown as a possible answer and the question stays open.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Meetings and open questions. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.21.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-meeting-to-specs
@<minutes, transcript, meeting tool export, email, or chat thread>

Extract what matters for features. Match it to the specs we already have. Do not write a spec. Do not commit.
```
